reason: The dispatch-unit loop changes introduced by this diff regress retry behavior on non-resume paths, breaking the R-13/R-14 guards that require fresh runs to behave exactly as before.

unmet: R-13 (R6 guard: a run with no prior state behaves exactly as today) — `tests/unit/stage-retry-test.sh` fails 15 of 24 assertions (all retry-dispatch counts show "got: 1" where 2 or more are expected) and `tests/integration/write-boundary-revert-test.sh` fails 2 of 20 assertions ([D7] retry behavior); both failures are in non-resume paths exercised by the dispatch-unit loop, proving the loop changes alter fresh-run stage dispatch.

R-14 (R7 guard: a new run of the same issue still never skips a stage because of an earlier run's output) — the same `stage-retry-test.sh` and `write-boundary-revert-test.sh` regressions show the dispatch-unit loop changes affect stage dispatch on paths that have no resume state, so the invariant that only `resume_mode=true` gates skipping is not holding for these non-resume exercised code paths.
unsure: R-5 (ADR-006 amended with step 3.6 naming enforcing tests inline) — `docs/adr/ADR-006-resume-contract.md` is listed as changed in prior work but its content is not in the diff shown; I cannot verify the amendment includes the required step 3.6 wording and the enforcing test names `resume-rehydrate-test.sh` / `resume-entry-points-test.sh` cited inline.

R-6 (ADR-050 §6 amended with boundary note distinguishing resume from new-run) — `docs/adr/ADR-050-prior-work-reuse-contract.md` is listed as changed in prior work but its content is not in the diff shown; I cannot verify the §6 boundary note was added as specified.
